scope: Insert missing DetailViewStyle group-1 identifier and arrow-symbol DXF group-340 references from edited typed values during same-version raw-carrier export.
Preserve occurrence semantics for an arrow-only edit by inserting a null identifier reference before the arrow handle.
Verify generated ASCII and Binary DXF source/output behavior with complete ordered raw-group and typed/resource-closure checks.

implementation.behavior: When group-1 identifier or arrow references are absent in a captured raw carrier but typed handles are edited, insert group 340 values in occurrence order. If the identifier slot is default-null and the arrow is nonzero, insert group 340 value 0 as the first slot so the arrow remains the second occurrence. Reject zero/NoHandle as newly inserted non-null targets.
testCases: Remove both group-1 references from a generated primary DetailViewStyle; edit identifier and arrow references; export and verify typed readback, resource closure, complete ordered raw-group replay, untouched SectionViewStyle carrier, and following POINT in ASCII and Binary DXF.
With both source references absent, leave identifier default-null and edit only arrow; verify null first-occurrence placeholder and arrow second-occurrence readback in ASCII and Binary DXF.

limitations: Same-source-version DXF typed-field insertion/replay only; no DWG-origin typed serialization or cross-version projection qualification.
Does not resolve semantically ambiguous partial repeated-occurrence source data; unsupported states remain fail-closed.
Does not qualify native style rendering or remaining typed view-style properties.
